title: Revenue shows a negative figure when credits exceed sales
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as a user whose role has the Reports permission, for example an Administrator. To check a role: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > the Reports permission is switched on.
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. Pick a workplace in the workplace selector in the top bar where no invoice has been created today. To confirm: Reports > Sales > pick a custom range of today only in the calendar (click today twice, then Apply). The total must read $0.00.
  4. Have an invoice from an earlier day in that workplace with a part on it (e.g. a part with Sell Price $160.00). Find it on the work order's Finance tab.
custom_steps:
1. On that earlier invoice: Finance tab > the invoice's three-dot menu > Issue Credit.
  2. Pick the part to return (e.g. the $160.00 part), choose Store Credit and submit.
  3. Open the dashboard.
  4. On the Revenue tile, open the range pill, pick today only in the calendar (click today twice) and click Apply.
  5. Read the Revenue headline.
  6. Click the arrow icon beside "Revenue" and read the Sales report total for the same range.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Revenue headline shows the true negative figure, e.g. "-$160.00" (sales today $0.00 minus credits today $160.00). It does not show $0.00.
  • The Sales report total for today reads the same negative figure, to the cent.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9575 (Story 3, Measure Formulas and Report Parity); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 3.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-E1: “The Revenue figure can be negative when credit memos in the range exceed sales; the dashboard shows the true negative figure rather than flooring it at zero.”
